import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Revenue by product (horizontal bar chart)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax1.barh(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Total Revenue by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=9)

# Add value labels to bars
for i, (bar, value) in enumerate(zip(bars, product_revenue.values)):
    ax1.text(value + max(product_revenue.values)*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
             f'${value:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales distribution by age group (pie chart)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(age_sales)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                   colors=colors, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
ax2.set_title('Revenue Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Average transaction value by size and takeaway status (heatmap)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
size_takeaway = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='size', columns='is_takeaway',
                               aggfunc='mean', fill_value=0)
size_takeaway.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
sns.heatmap(size_takeaway, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlOrRd', cbar_kws={'label': 'Average Sale ($)'},
            ax=ax3, linewidths=1, linecolor='white')
ax3.set_title('Average Sale by Size & Takeaway Status', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax3.set_xlabel('Takeaway Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Size', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=10)

# 4. Payment method usage (bar chart)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
bars4 = ax4.bar(payment_counts.index, payment_counts.values, color=plt.cm.Paired(np.arange(len(payment_counts))))
ax4.set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Payment Method Usage', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=10)
ax4.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar, value in zip(bars4, payment_counts.values):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(payment_counts.values)*0.01,
             f'{value:,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 5. Hourly sales pattern (line chart)
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax5.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8)
ax5.fill_between(hourly_sales.index, 0, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.3)
ax5.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Hourly Sales Pattern', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax5.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
ax5.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=10)
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.4)

# 6. Quantity distribution by product (box plot)
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='product', y='quantity', ax=ax6, palette='Set2')
ax6.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Quantity per Transaction', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Quantity Distribution by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=10)
ax6.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9)

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
